# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

enhance lives and create a better world.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

### Biodegradable Products

bags and containers designed to break down naturally.

alternatives that break down rapidly in natural environments.

materials that conserve resources and reduce carbon emissions.

Workshops, seminars, and campaigns raising awareness about sustainable alternatives, informing
consumers, businesses, and policymakers.

alternatives and make sustainable choices more accessible.

materials and technologies aligned with sustainability.

environmental crisis. Traditional recycling can't cope with the volume. Compostable alternatives
still leave behind microplastics. The world needs a fundamentally different approach.

Complete Conversion

biomass, water, and carbon dioxide. This closed-loop system supports carbon neutrality by returning
organic matter to the earth.

03

### Complete Breakdown, No Microplastic Residues

Unlike conventional biodegradable materials that fragment into microplastics, BioFuture's additives
ensure a complete microbial consumption, leaving no harmful residues or toxic chemicals.

Environmentally Safe

The end products — biomass, water, and CO₂ — are non-toxic, contributing to soil health and
environmental regeneration without any adverse ecological impact.

04

### Recycling Compatibility & Circular Economy

Our additives' recycling-friendly design makes plastics fully recyclable within existing systems.
They maintain their integrity until exposed to a specific microbial environment, ensuring that
recycling streams are not contaminated or disrupted.

Supporting Circularity

By converting plastics into biomass, BioFuture supports the circular economy, enabling a sustainable
lifecycle from production to regeneration.

industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,

multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

regional manufacturers.

proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]

## What is a HTML color code?

A HTML color code is an identifier used to represent a color on the web and within other digital
assets. Common color codes are in the forms of: a keyword name, a hexadecimal value, a RGB (red,
green, blue) triplet, or a HSL (hue, saturation, lightness) triplet. Different values allow for
16,777,216 potential colors to be chosen.

For example, the color red can be identifier using the following formats:
* red (keyword name)
* #ff0000 (hex)
* (255,0,0) (RGB)
* (0, 100%, 50%) (HSL)

Because there are so many colors to choose from, tools have been created to make the task of
selection much simpler. A color picker allows a user to select a color by clicking on visual range
of color to pin-point an exact code. A color chart provides a listing of common colors for quick
selection.

To use a selected color code within your web page, you could place the following attribute within a
given element to change its background color to red: `style="background-color: #ff0000;"`

## What are HTML color codes used for?

HTML color codes are used within HTML and CSS to create web design color schemes. They are primarily
used by web designers, graphic designers, computer programmers, and digital illustrators. Choosing
the correct web colors can be exhausting, but it is a great skill to have, especially for marketing
purposes.

To read more about html colors, Wikipedia has a good resource on web colors:
[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_colors][27].

## What are basic HTML color codes?

A few common color codes are:
black, #000000, rgb(0,0,0) white, #FFFFFF, rgb(255,255,255) silver, #C0C0C0, rgb(192,192,192 grey,
#808080, rgb(128,128,128) maroon, #800000, rgb(128,0,0) red, #FF0000, rgb(255,0,0) purple, #800080,
rgb(128,0,128) fuchsia, #FF00FF, rgb(255,0,255) green, #008000, rgb(0,128,0) lime, #00FF00,
rgb(0,255,0) olive, #808000, rgb(128,128,0) yellow, #FFFF00, rgb(255,255,0) navy, #000080,
rgb(0,0,128) blue, #0000FF, rgb(0,0,255) teal, #008080, rgb(0,128,128) aqua, #00FFFF, rgb(0,255,255)

## Innovating with Purpose: Sustainable Chemical Solutions for Modern Industries

We provide a plethora of chemical solutions for contemporary industries. Our commitment to being
eco-friendly does not hinder our provision of high-performance Adhesives modern Inks and
environmentally acceptable Coatings that simplify and enhance performance.

At the forefront of chemical manufacturing, we provide a diverse portfolio of high-performance
chemicals tailored for today’s dynamic industrial needs. From advanced adhesives and cutting-edge
inks to eco-friendly coatings, our solutions are designed to deliver exceptional results while
supporting global sustainability goals.

As a trusted sustainable chemical manufacturer, we are deeply committed to reducing environmental
impact without compromising on quality or efficiency. Our sustainable chemical production processes
incorporate cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality control to ensure our
products meet the highest industry standards.
We believe that innovation and sustainability can and must go hand in hand. Whether you’re seeking
performance-driven solutions for packaging, construction, printing, or specialty applications, our
chemical technologies simplify workflows, improve productivity, and help our partners build a
greener future.

## Sustainable Solutions That Inspire Change

Managing Development Using Investigations, Technologies, and Sustainable Adhesives, Inks, and

## Innovating with Purpose: Sustainable Chemical Solutions for Modern Industries

We provide a plethora of chemical solutions for contemporary industries. Our commitment to being
eco-friendly does not hinder our provision of high-performance Adhesives modern Inks and
environmentally acceptable Coatings that simplify and enhance performance.

At the forefront of chemical manufacturing, we provide a diverse portfolio of high-performance
chemicals tailored for today’s dynamic industrial needs. From advanced adhesives and cutting-edge
inks to eco-friendly coatings, our solutions are designed to deliver exceptional results while
supporting global sustainability goals.

As a trusted sustainable chemical manufacturer, we are deeply committed to reducing environmental
impact without compromising on quality or efficiency. Our sustainable chemical production processes
incorporate cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality control to ensure our
products meet the highest industry standards.
We believe that innovation and sustainability can and must go hand in hand. Whether you’re seeking
performance-driven solutions for packaging, construction, printing, or specialty applications, our
chemical technologies simplify workflows, improve productivity, and help our partners build a
greener future.

## Solutions

[adhesives-icon]

### Adhesives and Sealants

Our additives improve processability, durability, and custom performance across formulations.

[ink]

### Paints, Inks, and Varnishes

Designed for impact & durability, our inks & varnishes deliver vibrant prints with excellent
adhesion & clarity.

[coatings]

### Specialty Coatings

We offer functional coatings—barrier, heat seal, UV—that enhance protection, sealing, and shelf
appeal.

[resin-icon-67f50ee65b380]

### Resins and Binders

Essential for strength and flexibility, our resins and binders ensure consistent film performance
across packaging applications.
[magic-hat-9433499-67f50ee61fc83]

### Additives

Our additives improve processability, durability, and custom performance across formulations.

and innovation.

## Research and Development of the company

Research & Development is the pivotal focus in which all our activities revolve. Using a fine blend
of qualified personnel and technology, we are always striving to create green chemistry innovations
that are superior in performance. There is an emphasis on environmental sustainability at all stages
of the development cycle so that the products can assist companies to thrive in an environmentally
friendly manner.

If you have a question or are looking for a bespoke solution, do contact us and let us explain how

## FAQS

[ What industries does Innokan serve with its sustainable chemical solutions?
][21]

Innokan caters to a diverse range of industries, including packaging, printing, construction,
plastics, rubber, and advanced materials. Our eco-friendly adhesives, inks, and coatings are
designed to meet the specific needs of each sector while promoting sustainability.

[ How does Innokan ensure the sustainability of its chemical products?
][22]

We prioritize sustainability by integrating green chemistry principles into our product development.
Our manufacturing processes utilize cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality
control to minimize environmental impact without compromising on performance.

[ Where is Innokan's manufacturing facility located?
][23]

Our state-of-the-art facility is situated in Kundli, Sonipat, Haryana, strategically positioned to
serve clients across India and beyond.

[ What types of inks does Innokan offer for printing applications?
][24]

We provide a variety of inks tailored for different substrates and applications, including:

Water-Based Inks: Ideal for paper and cardboard, offering reduced VOC emissions.

Solvent-Based Inks: Suitable for non-porous surfaces like plastic and metal, ensuring excellent
adhesion.

UV-Curable Inks: Designed for high-speed printing with minimal environmental impact.
Each type is engineered to deliver vibrant prints with superior adhesion and clarity.

[ How can I contact Innokan for inquiries or orders?
][25]

You can reach us via email at info@innokan.com or visit our website at innokan.com for more
information. Our team is ready to assist you with your chemical solution needs.

# Elevating Your Chemistry

For over 50 years, J R Hess Company has been a trusted and valued partner in the specialty chemical
supply chain, supporting innovation with sustainable solutions and customized development for
formulators and manufacturers across a broad range of markets.

[About Us][42] [Get in touch][43]

## Featured Applications

## Process Cleaning

Helping companies meet performance and safety objectives with custom blends, alternative solvents,
and surfactant-based chemistry.

[Learn more][44]

## Life Sciences

Sourcing, storing, and delivering active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for growing companies in
the life sciences sector.

[Learn more][45]

## Inks and Coatings

Supporting ink, polymer, and coating development with formulation, blending, testing and analysis,
and supply chain services.

[Learn more][46]

## product stewardship

## Our Quality Standards

J R Hess Company is committed to maintaining the highest standards of product stewardship in our
chemical processing, warehousing and transportation practices.

To meet our environmental, health, safety & security objectives, we operate according to rigorous
quality standards under the NSF ISO 9001:2015 quality management system and the Alliance for
Chemical Distribution (ACD) Responsible Distribution program.

#### [Learn More About Our Company][47]

## Operating Since 1969

We have been working in this field for 30 years and we are really excited to move forward with more
new things.

# You create quality, we just help improve it

[Discover now][15] [Our solutions][16]
Image
[Discover Galactic]

## Your partner in natural Antimicrobial Solutions, Lactic Acid and Lactates.

Galactic is one of the world’s leading producers of lactic acid and its derivatives for over 30
years.
Through a fermentation process of sugar and non-GMO microorganisms, we pride ourselves on developing
a broad range of natural antimicrobials and ingredients, all dedicated to food and non-food
producers.

[play_arrow Discover Galactic][17]

## Expertise

Galactic drives innovation through its dynamic and skilled team of researchers, stretching across
the globe from Belgium to China and the United States. 

Our Research and Development department excels with a strategic structure encompassing four core
areas of expertise: Fermentation, Analytical Sciences, Application, and New Product Development.
This diverse array of specializations propels us forward in delivering cutting-edge solutions.

[Read moreeast][18]

Image
[Solutions]

## Solutions

With a large and customized range of solutions, Galactic is on its way to cover a major part of the
challenges that tomorrow's world will have to face in the food industry.

[Read moreeast][19]

## Applications

Galactic offers a diverse range of natural, fermentation-based ingredients suited for enhancing
flavor, freshness, and safety across various applications, ranging from meat, plant-based foods, and
prepared meals to dairy, bakery, and beverages. 

Our portfolio also extends to animal health, with nutritious pet food and farm animal feed
additives, alongside eco-friendly solutions for personal care, home care, and industrial uses.
Experience the benefits of our ingredients in delivering quality, taste, and sustainability in every
aspect of your life.

[Read moreeast][20]

Image
[Applications]

## Careers

At Galactic, passion and diversity are the watchwords. With our ambition to improve consumers’ lives
by developing safe, healthy, sustainable, and quality food products, we're looking for
self-motivated individuals with a particular sensitivity to sustainability and innovation.

[Read moreeast][21]

### [Antimicrobial agents for food processing: definition, types and uses ][24]

There's no single antimicrobial agent that solves every microbial challenge in food processing. From
organic acids and bacteriocins to fermentates and plant-derived compounds, each type works through a
distinct mechanism, targets a different microbial spectrum, and comes with its own matrix
sensitivities and regulatory constraints. We break down the main categories, how they function, and
why effectiveness always comes down to context.

compliance, R&D microbial risk assessment]

### [What does microbial control mean in food processing? ][27]

Microbial control isn't about eliminating every microorganism, it's about managing risk
systematically, from raw materials to distribution. We explore how physical, chemical, and
biological methods work together under the hurdle concept, why HACCP remains foundational to food
safety, and what R&D teams need to consider when designing microbial control strategies that protect
both safety and shelf-life.

timely, seamless deliveries that meet the needs of our clients. Our commitment to global standards

Orison Marketing was formed in 1997 in Abilene, TX with the goal to provide safer and
environmentally friendly alternative cleaners to Industry, Gov't/Military and Household. Over the
next 10 years, we refined our product line to add products for corrosion, antifreeze / heat
transfer, odor control and disinfecting / sanitizing based on close relationships and communication
from our customers like you.

We incorporate high quality standards throughout our process and began preparing for ISO
certification in 2009. In 2011, we obtained our first ISO 9001 certification. We are proud of this
achievement and hope it provides our customers with assurance that our quality and product standards
are audited and reviewed for continual improvement.

## Prasol Chemicals Ltd. – Driving Chemistry, Empowering Progress

At **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.**, we are committed to excellence in chemical manufacturing, offering
high-quality **solvents, additives, and specialty chemicals** to industries worldwide. With a strong
foundation in **innovation, sustainability, and reliability**, we have established ourselves as a
trusted partner for businesses across **Home & Personal Care**, **Performance Chemicals**,
**Agrochemicals**, **Pharmaceutical** and **PICA** (Paints / Inks / Construction /
Adhesives) industries. 

Sustainability is at the heart of our operations. We prioritize **eco-friendly processes,
responsible sourcing, and waste reduction** to minimize our environmental footprint. By continuously
innovating and adopting sustainable practices, we aim to contribute to a greener future while
meeting the evolving needs of our customers. 

With a commitment to **quality, innovation, and sustainability**, **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.** is your
trusted partner for high-performance chemical solutions. Whether you’re looking for **reliable
supply chain support, advanced chemical formulations, or customized solutions**, we are here to help
you achieve success.

## Prasol Chemicals Ltd. – Driving Chemistry, Empowering Progress

At **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.**, we are committed to excellence in chemical manufacturing, offering
high-quality **solvents, additives, and specialty chemicals** to industries worldwide. With a strong
foundation in **innovation, sustainability, and reliability**, we have established ourselves as a
trusted partner for businesses across **Home & Personal Care**, **Performance Chemicals**,
**Agrochemicals**, **Pharmaceutical** and **PICA** (Paints / Inks / Construction /
Adhesives) industries. 

Sustainability is at the heart of our operations. We prioritize **eco-friendly processes,
responsible sourcing, and waste reduction** to minimize our environmental footprint. By continuously
innovating and adopting sustainable practices, we aim to contribute to a greener future while
meeting the evolving needs of our customers. 

With a commitment to **quality, innovation, and sustainability**, **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.** is your
trusted partner for high-performance chemical solutions. Whether you’re looking for **reliable
supply chain support, advanced chemical formulations, or customized solutions**, we are here to help
you achieve success.

Quants helps clients identify the right levers to activate to reach their targets, defining
actionable climate transition strategies and nature positive strategies to mitigate their impacts,
as well as adaptation strategies that support business resilience.
[ Discover ][63]

### Sustainable Supply Chain Management

Quantis helps companies tackle supply chain challenges by focusing on the biggest opportunities for
measurable impact — whether they can be addressed by implementing regenerative agriculture programs
or strategies to fight deforestation. From there, we pinpoint the best pathways for implementation,
helping you plan for the best Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) systems to measure
progress and help establish chain of custody models that ensure you can credibly report on your
efforts.

One of the most effective ways companies can improve environmental performance is by reshaping their
product portfolios. We help companies improve product portfolios through practical, integrated
action.

Quantis brings together strategy, reporting and communications to translate sustainability ambition
into action. Our work spans ESG strategy and frameworks, reporting and disclosure, brand narratives
and environmental claims and stakeholder engagement across internal and external audiences.

# SUSTAINABLE PLASTICS
# FOR A BETTER TOMORROW

## Our Story

RRAJ Bioplast is a conscious material science company designed to create an alternate eco-system. We
strive to convert waste across industrial practices into a valuable ingredient towards developing a
better world promoting zero wastage, sustainability and circularity.

 

Through our innovation in processing waste and giving it a second life, we believe we can be part of
a solution addressing the current crisis of waste management, which has led to endlessly filling up
of landfills with plastic and industrial waste. We aim to provide a mindful and profitable way of
solving a real world problem. Through our vision and our internal competencies on high volume
manufacturing, technical expertise and a passion for innovation we empower product manufacturers to
achieve a positive environmental impact in consumer and business markets.

 

We are inspired to build a business that cherishes the need to build a better world driven by
sustainable manufacturing practices and circularity, leading to a world that is environmentally
conscious. At RRAJ Bioplast, we are committed to a responsible and mindful future.

[connecting.png]

## 1. Waste

We divert waste from reaching landfills.

## 2. Sustainable      Granules

Through our innovative processing, we transform the waste into sustainable plastic granules.

## 3. End Product

Our granules can be substituted for injection moulding and extrusion to make household items, toys,
furniture, automobile interiors,etc

## Product Applications

-Different grades available for injection molding and extrusion.

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

## Touching the lives of billions daily, delivering value as one of India’s largest
## specialty chemical manufacturers.

Rossari Biotech Limited is one of India's largest specialty chemical manufacturers, delivering
high-performance solutions that touch billions of lives daily. With over four decades of experience,
the company offers 4,300+ products to 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries. Operating seven
manufacturing facilities with 332,000+ MTPA capacity, Rossari Biotech serves diverse industries
including Textiles, Home Personal Care and Performance Chemicals, and Animal Health and Nutrition.
The company leads the market across four core chemistries: surfactants, polymers, silicones, and
enzymes. Committed to sustainability through green chemistry and zero-liquid-discharge facilities,
Rossari Biotech leverages its strong foundation and experienced leadership to shape the future of
specialty chemistry, creating lasting value for stakeholders worldwide.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

### Strategic Insights

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop

## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

## Economic Bioplastic to Finally beat Petrochemical Plastic.

At Sustainable Chemicals™, we are bringing novel bioplastics materials to market that will
revolutionize how bioplastics are adopted and used. Our ambitious goal is backed by economics and
superior performance, existing bioplastics can’t match, and will enable us to bring sustainable
bioplastics to producers and consumers in the plastics industry.

## **OUR MISSION IS TO SOLVE THE PLASTIC PROBLEM
## **

> *″Bioplastics have been around for decades, but the technology remains limited to niche
> applications because they have inferior properties and are more expensive than traditional
> plastics. The only way to achieve meaningful environmental change is to design a bioplastic that
> is cost and performance competitive with petroleum-based plastics. That is why I founded
> Sustainable Chemicals™.″*
> 
> **
> 
> * – Silvia Luebben, Sust-Chem CEO and Founder*
> 
> **
> 
> **
> 
> **

### Novel BioPlastics

We have novel bioplastics platform made from raw material obtained from biomass. This reduces the
carbon footprint of our product by 45% compared to petrochemical plastics.

### BioDegradation

If dispersed in the environment, Sust-Chem’s bioplastics degrade into benign molecules that can be
used by nature as building blocks.

If collected, our biopolymers can be chemically recycled.

### Cost-competitive

Petrochemical plastics are ubiquitous because they are convenient and cheap. Our chemistry does not
require fermentation compared to other bioplastics, which allows us to scale economically and become
cost-competitive with the petrochemical plastics.

### Actual Plastic Properties

Existing bioplastic products do not have a plastic look, feel, or application. Our bioplastics are
designed to have properties that match conventional petrochemical plastics to provide diverse
product applications.

## We Have the Power to Impact Our Future, and We’re Doing Something About It

 We are drowning in plastic pollution. 
* By the year 2050 there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish .
* Non-biodegradable plastics breakdown into smaller fragments, called microplastics, which enter our
  drinking water and food supply.  Each person consumes about half a pound of microplastics per
  year.
* Plastic manufacture and incineration accounts for 13% of global carbon dioxide emissions, a
  leading cause of global warming.
* Only 9% of plastic is actually recycled.
* Current alternatives to conventional polymers have made great technological advances, however
  their used is limited to niche applications because their cost is higher and their performance in
  inferior to that of conventional fossil fuel based plastics.

## OUR DUTY

## Bring to market a family of sustainable bioplastics that compete with petrochemical plastics in
## price and performance. 

## BIODEGRADABLE

Our material has a benign end of life whether it is recycled, up-cycled or lost to the environment.

[Learn More][6]

## RENEWABLE

The monomer is sourced from biomass which allows us to reduce the carbon footprint of our plastics
by 45%.

[Learn More][7]

## NONPERSISTANT

Our plastic breaks down into benign materials if improperly disposed.

[Learn More][8]

## NONTOXIC

The monomer is present in soy sauce and has a natural metabolic pathway.

[Learn More][9]

## PROPERTIES

Mechanical properties of our biopolymer match conventional plastics.

[Learn More][10]

# Shenzhen TAV Vape Co., Ltd.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in the world-renowned "E-cig City" of Shenzhen, TAV Vape is an
innovative technology company dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and global
distribution of premium electronic cigarettes and vaporizer hardware. We engineer the ultimate
flavorful experience — giving consumers a healthier, smarter choice.

## About TAV Vape — Premium Vaporizer Manufacturer

Shenzhen TAV Vape Co., Ltd. is an innovative technology company engaged in the research and
development, manufacturing, trading, and selling of high-quality electronic cigarettes (E-cig) and
related products. Our company aims to offer leading designs and the highest standards of quality to
create the best electronic cigarettes.

We are pursuing the ultimate flavorful experience and striving for their satisfaction to give them a
healthier choice. With a factory covering more than 5,000 square meters and over 10 years of R&D
expertise, we possess the full capability to turn any OEM/ODM concept into a successful,
market-ready product.
* World-class manufacturing facility in Shenzhen's E-cig hub
* Dedicated in-house R&D team with 10+ years of expertise
* Full OEM/ODM capabilities — concept to finished product
* Strict quality control across every production stage
* Serving North America, Europe, and global markets

## Our Product Range

From vape cartridges to complete starter kits, TAV Vape delivers a comprehensive portfolio
engineered for performance, safety, and superior user experience.

🛢️

### Vape Cartridges

High-precision ceramic and CCELL-compatible cartridges engineered for consistent oil flow,
full-spectrum flavor delivery, and leak-proof performance.

🔋

### Vape Batteries

510-thread and proprietary batteries with variable voltage, USB-C charging, and long-cycle-life
cells — designed for reliability in daily use.

✏️

### Vape Pens

Slim, discreet all-in-one vape pens combining battery and cartridge in a single ergonomic form
factor, ideal for retail and brand partnerships.

🎁

### Vape Starter Kits

Complete ready-to-use starter kits packaged for retail shelves — including device, charger, and user
guide — perfect for brand launches.

💨

### Disposable Vape Pods

Pre-filled disposable pod systems with draw-activated firing, multiple flavor compatibility, and
tamper-evident packaging for compliance markets.

🌿

### CBD / THC Vaporizer Hardware

Specialized vaporizer hardware adapted for CBD, THC, and essential oil delivery — designed to meet
the strict requirements of regulated cannabis markets.

[TAV Vape Global Production Market Distribution]

## Our Global Markets

TAV Vape's products are trusted by distributors, retailers, and brand owners across the globe. Our
primary market is North America — with the United States accounting for approximately 90% of our
total market share, followed by Canada. Our growing European presence includes key markets such as
the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Italy.

We understand the regulatory landscape of each market we serve, ensuring our products meet local
compliance standards including TPD requirements for Europe and FCC certifications for the United
States.

🇨🇦 Canada

## Our Certifications

TAV Vape products are certified to meet the most rigorous international safety, electromagnetic, and
regulatory standards — giving our partners confidence in every shipment.

🏅

### CE

European Conformity certification confirming our products meet EU health, safety, and environmental
protection standards.

♻️

### ROHS

Restriction of Hazardous Substances compliance, ensuring our devices are free from lead, mercury,
and other harmful materials.

📡

### FCC

Federal Communications Commission certification for the US market, verifying electromagnetic
compatibility and radio frequency compliance.

📋

### TPD

Tobacco Products Directive compliance for the European Union, ensuring our vape products meet all EU
tobacco and nicotine regulations.

###### Custom Specialty Chemical Manufacturing

# VanDeMark — Phosgene Derivatives & Other Specialty Chemicals

Trusted by industry leaders for our unwavering commitment to safety, innovation, and manufacturing
excellence, VanDeMark delivers precision-engineered specialty chemicals. For more than 70 years,
we’ve provided unequaled expertise in custom phosgene derivatives and complex chemical
manufacturing.

[Contact Us][30]

#### [Synthesis Capabilities][31]

From phosgenation and chlorination to hydrazine, acylation, and esterification, our team has the
synthesis capabilities and experience to address your requirements.

#### [Process Capabilities][32]

Our process capabilities include batch synthesis, liquid and solids handling, and distillation
services to meet your requirements

#### [R&D][33]

VanDeMark offers unique capabilities in the development and commercialization of phosgene-based
products and additional complex chemistries.

#### [Plant Scale Production][34]

We are flexible in terms of product quantities, adding new material to existing product families,
and in meeting unique and specialized needs of our customers.

###### Products

## Tailored Custom Chemical Manufacturing

VanDeMark provides a wide range of chemical intermediates based on phosgene and associated
chemistries that are utilized in highly demanding applications. We develop customized solutions
addressing specific customer requirements across a variety of markets.

## Who We Are at VanDeMark Chemical

Since 1951, VanDeMark has excelled in supplying the materials and life sciences markets with
products based on phosgene and associated complex chemistries. We safely transform complex chemicals
into essential ingredients for our customers’ products, which help improve and protect lives.
Safety, quality, service, and sustainability are key to how we operate.

VanDeMark is a trusted, long-tenured supplier to many top-tier companies. We serve a diverse
end-market mix with significant exposure in the material, life sciences, and consumer markets.

A VETTÓ Kft. profilja 1993 óta a hőközlő folyadékok, vegyi anyagok és műanyagipari termékek
forgalmazása.


Célunk, hogy partnereinkkel szoros együttműködést alakítsunk ki, mely alapját termékeink és
kiszállításaink magas színvonala képezi, amely veszélyes vegyi áruk kereskedelme során különösképpen
fontos kritérium. Az általunk forgalmazott termékeket az Ön számára legkényelmesebb módon rendelheti
meg e-mailben, telefonon, a honlapunkon vagy akár személyesen is, melyeket rövid határidővel címre
szállítunk. Termékeink listáját úgy állítottuk össze, hogy partnereink igényeit teljeskörűen
kielégíthessük.


Fontos számunkra, hogy az ökológiai lábnyomunk a lehető legkisebb legyen, és ennek érdekében a
környezettudatosság jegyében járunk el nap mint nap.

### Léteznek növényi eredetű, és így fenntartható, glikolos közvetítőközegek?

"A legkörnyezetbarátabb terméket valójában elő sem kell állítanunk - újra"


 Az egyre inkább előtérbe kerülő körforgásos gazdaság egyik alappillére a lehetőségek szerinti
legnagyobb mértékű regenerálás és újbóli felhasználás. Ennek a folyamatnak köszönhetően a termékek
és anyagok élettartama meghosszabbodik, a felesleges üvegházhatású gázok kibocsátása, a
hulladékokkal egyetemben, pedig a lehető legkisebbre csökken.

   Ez a módszer már a glikol alapú ...

[Tovább][16]

  A fenntartható technológia területén állandó fejlődést tapasztalhatunk, melyben a növényi alapú

## Rólunk

A VETTÓ Kft. profilja 1993 óta a hőközlő folyadékok, vegyi anyagok és műanyagipari termékek
forgalmazása.


Célunk, hogy partnereinkkel szoros együttműködést alakítsunk ki, mely alapját termékeink és
kiszállításaink magas színvonala képezi, amely veszélyes vegyi áruk kereskedelme során különösképpen
fontos kritérium. Az általunk forgalmazott termékeket az Ön számára legkényelmesebb módon rendelheti
meg e-mailben, telefonon, a honlapunkon vagy akár személyesen is, melyeket rövid határidővel címre
szállítunk. Termékeink listáját úgy állítottuk össze, hogy partnereink igényeit teljeskörűen
kielégíthessük.


Fontos számunkra, hogy az ökológiai lábnyomunk a lehető legkisebb legyen, és ennek érdekében a
környezettudatosság jegyében járunk el nap mint nap.


A sikeres együttműködés reményében,

## Frequently Asked Queries

Q1. What are your top 5 chemical products currently sold in B2B?

Our top B2B products include Di Potassium Phosphate, Mono Sodium Phosphate, Ammonium Sulphate,
Sodium Acetate, and Di Ammonium Phosphate — widely used across agriculture, industrial processing,
and water treatment sectors.

Q2. Do you provide COA, MSDS, and TDS for each chemical product?

Yes, we provide COA, MSDS, TDS, and all necessary documentation for every batch shipped — ensuring
full transparency and compliance.

Q3. Can you describe the grade, application, and technical advantage of each product?

Yes, we offer detailed specifications, use-case applications, and grade comparisons for every
product we supply, tailored to your industry.

Q4. Do you customize blends or concentrations if a buyer requests?

Yes, we offer customized chemical compositions or concentration levels based on specific buyer
requirements or application needs.

Q5. What is the shelf life and packaging format of your chemical products?

Most products have a shelf life of 2+ years. We offer 25kg, 50kg, and jumbo bags (FIBC), with
moisture-resistant and export-grade packaging options.

Q6. Do you offer trial quantities or product sampling before bulk orders?

Yes, we provide trial samples and small lot quantities for evaluation, especially for new customers
or custom formulations.

# Better chemistry for a healthier planet

By restricting hazardous chemical input and adopting sustainable chemical management practices,
clean input can be delivered in any industry.
The ZDHC Manufacturing Restricted Substances List (MRSL) helps industries clearly communicate,
within a unified requirement, chemicals that are harmful and work on eliminating these from supply
chains.

## At ZDHC we believe the MRSL is the answer

From automotive to electronics, home goods to packaging, every sector that relies on chemicals has a
role to play. The ZDHC MRSL offers a ready-made, globally recognised framework to phase out harmful
substances at the source. It’s practical, science-based, and designed for real-world implementation.
The ZDHC MRSL helps you reduce risk, stay ahead of regulation, and future-proof your business while
protecting the environment. 

Why start from scratch, when the solution already exists?

[Learn more about MRSL][7]

## ZDHC Impact Areas

Water Stewardship

Clean water starts with better chemistry. Every drop protected through safer choices.

Biodiversity

Protecting nature’s balance through safer chemistry. Preserving ecosystems one chemical decision at
a time.

Circularity

Safe materials, endless possibilities. Creating tomorrow’s resources through today’s responsible
choices.

Greenhouse Gas Emissions

Climate-smart chemistry for a cooler planet. Reducing our carbon footprint with every formulation.

## Pioneering industry
## since 2015

In 2011, the 'Detox My Fashion' campaign sparked a movement that eliminated toxic wastewater,
engaged over 350 industry signatories, and created the Sustainable Chemical Management Framework.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## How it works: turning *plastic* into biomass

01

### Advanced Molecular Transformation

Our additives are engineered to alter the chemical structure of the polymer, making it attractive to
naturally occurring microbes. This alteration is imperceptible during the product's use but becomes
active only in microbe-rich environments like landfills, oceans, or composting sites.

Stability During Use

Unlike other degradable plastics, our materials maintain their full strength, flexibility, and
usability throughout their lifecycle. They do not degrade or compromise functionality during
manufacturing, usage, or storage.

02

### Microbial Activation & Biomass Conversion

Only when the product reaches a microbe-rich environment, the altered polymer structure is
recognised as a food source by specific microbes. This initiates the breakdown process, where
microbes consume the material.

Complete Conversion

The polymers are fully metabolised by these microbes, converting the plastics into non-toxic
biomass, water, and carbon dioxide. This closed-loop system supports carbon neutrality by returning
organic matter to the earth.

03

### Complete Breakdown, No Microplastic Residues

Unlike conventional biodegradable materials that fragment into microplastics, BioFuture's additives
ensure a complete microbial consumption, leaving no harmful residues or toxic chemicals.

Environmentally Safe

The end products — biomass, water, and CO₂ — are non-toxic, contributing to soil health and
environmental regeneration without any adverse ecological impact.

04

### Recycling Compatibility & Circular Economy

Our additives' recycling-friendly design makes plastics fully recyclable within existing systems.
They maintain their integrity until exposed to a specific microbial environment, ensuring that
recycling streams are not contaminated or disrupted.

Supporting Circularity

By converting plastics into biomass, BioFuture supports the circular economy, enabling a sustainable
lifecycle from production to regeneration.

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## What is a HTML color code?

A HTML color code is an identifier used to represent a color on the web and within other digital
assets. Common color codes are in the forms of: a keyword name, a hexadecimal value, a RGB (red,
green, blue) triplet, or a HSL (hue, saturation, lightness) triplet. Different values allow for
16,777,216 potential colors to be chosen.

For example, the color red can be identifier using the following formats:
* red (keyword name)
* #ff0000 (hex)
* (255,0,0) (RGB)
* (0, 100%, 50%) (HSL)

Because there are so many colors to choose from, tools have been created to make the task of
selection much simpler. A color picker allows a user to select a color by clicking on visual range
of color to pin-point an exact code. A color chart provides a listing of common colors for quick
selection.

To use a selected color code within your web page, you could place the following attribute within a
given element to change its background color to red: `style="background-color: #ff0000;"`

## What are HTML color codes used for?

HTML color codes are used within HTML and CSS to create web design color schemes. They are primarily
used by web designers, graphic designers, computer programmers, and digital illustrators. Choosing
the correct web colors can be exhausting, but it is a great skill to have, especially for marketing
purposes.

To read more about html colors, Wikipedia has a good resource on web colors:
[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_colors][27].

## What are basic HTML color codes?

A few common color codes are:
black, #000000, rgb(0,0,0) white, #FFFFFF, rgb(255,255,255) silver, #C0C0C0, rgb(192,192,192 grey,
#808080, rgb(128,128,128) maroon, #800000, rgb(128,0,0) red, #FF0000, rgb(255,0,0) purple, #800080,
rgb(128,0,128) fuchsia, #FF00FF, rgb(255,0,255) green, #008000, rgb(0,128,0) lime, #00FF00,
rgb(0,255,0) olive, #808000, rgb(128,128,0) yellow, #FFFF00, rgb(255,255,0) navy, #000080,
rgb(0,0,128) blue, #0000FF, rgb(0,0,255) teal, #008080, rgb(0,128,128) aqua, #00FFFF, rgb(0,255,255)

## Innovating with Purpose: Sustainable Chemical Solutions for Modern Industries

We provide a plethora of chemical solutions for contemporary industries. Our commitment to being
eco-friendly does not hinder our provision of high-performance Adhesives modern Inks and
environmentally acceptable Coatings that simplify and enhance performance.

At the forefront of chemical manufacturing, we provide a diverse portfolio of high-performance
chemicals tailored for today’s dynamic industrial needs. From advanced adhesives and cutting-edge
inks to eco-friendly coatings, our solutions are designed to deliver exceptional results while
supporting global sustainability goals.

As a trusted sustainable chemical manufacturer, we are deeply committed to reducing environmental
impact without compromising on quality or efficiency. Our sustainable chemical production processes
incorporate cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality control to ensure our
products meet the highest industry standards.
We believe that innovation and sustainability can and must go hand in hand. Whether you’re seeking
performance-driven solutions for packaging, construction, printing, or specialty applications, our
chemical technologies simplify workflows, improve productivity, and help our partners build a
greener future.

environmentally acceptable Coatings that simplify and enhance performance.

At the forefront of chemical manufacturing, we provide a diverse portfolio of high-performance
chemicals tailored for today’s dynamic industrial needs. From advanced adhesives and cutting-edge
inks to eco-friendly coatings, our solutions are designed to deliver exceptional results while
supporting global sustainability goals.

As a trusted sustainable chemical manufacturer, we are deeply committed to reducing environmental
impact without compromising on quality or efficiency. Our sustainable chemical production processes
incorporate cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality control to ensure our
products meet the highest industry standards.
We believe that innovation and sustainability can and must go hand in hand. Whether you’re seeking
performance-driven solutions for packaging, construction, printing, or specialty applications, our
chemical technologies simplify workflows, improve productivity, and help our partners build a
greener future.

# Elevating Your Chemistry

For over 50 years, J R Hess Company has been a trusted and valued partner in the specialty chemical
supply chain, supporting innovation with sustainable solutions and customized development for
formulators and manufacturers across a broad range of markets.

# You create quality, we just help improve it

[Discover now][15] [Our solutions][16]
Image
[Discover Galactic]

## Your partner in natural Antimicrobial Solutions, Lactic Acid and Lactates.

Galactic is one of the world’s leading producers of lactic acid and its derivatives for over 30
years.
Through a fermentation process of sugar and non-GMO microorganisms, we pride ourselves on developing
a broad range of natural antimicrobials and ingredients, all dedicated to food and non-food
producers.

[play_arrow Discover Galactic][17]

## Expertise

Galactic drives innovation through its dynamic and skilled team of researchers, stretching across
the globe from Belgium to China and the United States. 

Our Research and Development department excels with a strategic structure encompassing four core
areas of expertise: Fermentation, Analytical Sciences, Application, and New Product Development.
This diverse array of specializations propels us forward in delivering cutting-edge solutions.

[Read moreeast][18]

Image
[Solutions]

## Solutions

With a large and customized range of solutions, Galactic is on its way to cover a major part of the
challenges that tomorrow's world will have to face in the food industry.

[Read moreeast][19]

## Applications

Galactic offers a diverse range of natural, fermentation-based ingredients suited for enhancing
flavor, freshness, and safety across various applications, ranging from meat, plant-based foods, and
prepared meals to dairy, bakery, and beverages. 

Our portfolio also extends to animal health, with nutritious pet food and farm animal feed
additives, alongside eco-friendly solutions for personal care, home care, and industrial uses.
Experience the benefits of our ingredients in delivering quality, taste, and sustainability in every
aspect of your life.

[Read moreeast][20]

Image
[Applications]

## Careers

At Galactic, passion and diversity are the watchwords. With our ambition to improve consumers’ lives
by developing safe, healthy, sustainable, and quality food products, we're looking for
self-motivated individuals with a particular sensitivity to sustainability and innovation.

[Read moreeast][21]

### [Antimicrobial agents for food processing: definition, types and uses ][24]

There's no single antimicrobial agent that solves every microbial challenge in food processing. From
organic acids and bacteriocins to fermentates and plant-derived compounds, each type works through a
distinct mechanism, targets a different microbial spectrum, and comes with its own matrix
sensitivities and regulatory constraints. We break down the main categories, how they function, and
why effectiveness always comes down to context.

compliance, R&D microbial risk assessment]

### [What does microbial control mean in food processing? ][27]

Microbial control isn't about eliminating every microorganism, it's about managing risk
systematically, from raw materials to distribution. We explore how physical, chemical, and
biological methods work together under the hurdle concept, why HACCP remains foundational to food
safety, and what R&D teams need to consider when designing microbial control strategies that protect
both safety and shelf-life.

# We are Prakash Chemicals Agencies Private Limited - a symbol of entrepreneurial integrity and
# excellence for 70+ years now.

We are a one-stop source of speciality chemical products, linking chemical manufacturers and
end-users to provide innovative business solutions to more than 5,000 customers across more than 10
locations in different geographies.
Headquartered in Vadodara (Gujarat, India), with more than eight warehouses located in Surat,
Ahmedabad, Vapi, Rajkot, Ankleshwar, Mumbai and Maharashtra, our diverse portfolio of over 200
products and an equally diverse supplier base, makes us one of the leading brands in the
distribution of versatile chemicals in India.
Supported by our robust business model, we are dedicated to satisfy customer-needs by ensuring the
delivery of each order with speed, quality and accuracy.

## Prasol Chemicals Ltd. – Driving Chemistry, Empowering Progress

At **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.**, we are committed to excellence in chemical manufacturing, offering
high-quality **solvents, additives, and specialty chemicals** to industries worldwide. With a strong
foundation in **innovation, sustainability, and reliability**, we have established ourselves as a
trusted partner for businesses across **Home & Personal Care**, **Performance Chemicals**,
**Agrochemicals**, **Pharmaceutical** and **PICA** (Paints / Inks / Construction /
Adhesives) industries. 

Sustainability is at the heart of our operations. We prioritize **eco-friendly processes,
responsible sourcing, and waste reduction** to minimize our environmental footprint. By continuously
innovating and adopting sustainable practices, we aim to contribute to a greener future while
meeting the evolving needs of our customers. 

With a commitment to **quality, innovation, and sustainability**, **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.** is your
trusted partner for high-performance chemical solutions. Whether you’re looking for **reliable
supply chain support, advanced chemical formulations, or customized solutions**, we are here to help
you achieve success.

## Prasol Chemicals Ltd. – Driving Chemistry, Empowering Progress

At **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.**, we are committed to excellence in chemical manufacturing, offering
high-quality **solvents, additives, and specialty chemicals** to industries worldwide. With a strong
foundation in **innovation, sustainability, and reliability**, we have established ourselves as a
trusted partner for businesses across **Home & Personal Care**, **Performance Chemicals**,
**Agrochemicals**, **Pharmaceutical** and **PICA** (Paints / Inks / Construction /
Adhesives) industries. 

Sustainability is at the heart of our operations. We prioritize **eco-friendly processes,
responsible sourcing, and waste reduction** to minimize our environmental footprint. By continuously
innovating and adopting sustainable practices, we aim to contribute to a greener future while
meeting the evolving needs of our customers. 

With a commitment to **quality, innovation, and sustainability**, **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.** is your
trusted partner for high-performance chemical solutions. Whether you’re looking for **reliable
supply chain support, advanced chemical formulations, or customized solutions**, we are here to help
you achieve success.
